prompt: A young adult East Asian woman kneeling on a light beige towel spread on a beach, shot from above the head to near the calves. The subject is centered slightly to the right, body turned slightly to the left, kneeling with knees bent, one leg extended forward and the other tucked under; upper body leaning forward naturally, arms straight, hands supporting her on the towel. She looks directly at the camera with a quiet, soft, slightly lazy gaze, lips naturally parted, no obvious smile. She has a delicate oval face, almond deep brown eyes, natural thin brows, a slender nose bridge, and light nude-pink lips. Extremely light makeup, only natural lashes, fine eyeliner, soft blush, and moist lip color. Skin is fair and warm-toned, retaining real pores, fine vellus hair, slight skin tone variations, natural sweat, and sunlight highlights, no plastic skin smoothing. Long dark brown hair flowing naturally with a slight damp look and soft waves; light wispy bangs in front, some hair strands blown by the sea breeze across cheeks, shoulders, and chest, hair edges illuminated by the sunset. She wears a light sand, nude beige thin-strap triangle bikini, matte soft fabric, simple cut, color close to skin tone but with clear edges, natural fit, opaque. Some sand and moisture on the swimwear and skin. Background is a quiet beach, with light blue-green sea and gentle waves in the back left, dark islands or mountains in the distance, and a blurred coastline in the back right. The sun is at a low angle in the back right, creating warm golden side-backlighting, hair rim lighting, and highlights on shoulders, neck, and arms, with bright sparkling spots on the sea. Sky is a gradient of light gray-blue and cream gold, overall low saturation, low contrast, warm and transparent. Photography style: 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, close-up shot slightly below eye level, shallow depth of field, clear eyes, soft sea blur, real textures of sand, towel, skin, and swimwear, slight ISO 200 film grain, soft highlight bloom, a mix of Japanese portraiture and high-end lifestyle photography, photorealistic. Avoid: underage features, nudity, exposure, transparent swimwear, erotic poses, CG, anime, excessive skin smoothing, exaggerated body proportions, incorrect fingers, deformed legs/feet, stiff poses, strong HDR, over-sharpening, cluttered tourists, text, watermarks, logos.

promptZh: 一位年轻的东亚女性跪在 铺在海滩上的浅米色毛巾 上，镜头从头顶上方拍摄至小腿附近。主体略微偏右，身体微向左转，双膝弯曲跪地，一条腿向前伸展，另一条腿向内收；上身自然前倾，双臂伸直，双手撑在毛巾上。她直视镜头，眼神安静、柔和且略带慵懒，双唇自然微张，没有明显的笑容。她拥有精致的鹅蛋脸、深棕色的杏仁眼、自然的细眉、纤细的鼻梁和浅裸粉色的嘴唇。妆容极淡，仅有自然的睫毛、细眼线、柔和的腮红和水润的唇色。皮肤呈白皙暖色调，保留了真实的毛孔、细小的绒毛、细微的肤色差异、自然的汗水和阳光高光，无塑料感磨皮。深棕色长发自然垂落，带有轻微的湿润感和柔和的波浪卷；额前有稀疏的刘海，几缕发丝被海风吹拂在脸颊、肩膀和胸前，发丝边缘被日落光线照亮。她穿着 浅沙色、裸米色细肩带三角比基尼，哑光柔软面料，剪裁简约，颜色与肤色相近但边缘清晰，自然贴合，不透明。泳装和皮肤上带有少许沙粒和水汽。背景是安静的海滩，左后方是浅蓝绿色的海水和轻柔的海浪，远处有深色的岛屿或山脉，右后方是模糊的海岸线。太阳位于右后方低角度，营造出温暖的金色侧逆光，勾勒出头发的轮廓光，并在肩膀、颈部和手臂上形成高光，海面上闪烁着明亮的光斑。天空呈现浅灰蓝与奶油金的渐变色，整体低饱和度、低对比度，温暖而通透。摄影风格：85mm 人像镜头，f/1.8 光圈，略低于视平线的近景拍摄，浅景深，眼神清晰，海景虚化柔和，沙子、毛巾、皮肤和泳装的质感真实，带有轻微的 ISO 200 胶片颗粒感，柔和的高光溢出，融合了日系人像与高端生活方式摄影风格，照片级写实。避免：未成年特征、裸露、走光、透明泳装、色情姿势、CG、动漫、过度磨皮、夸张的身体比例、手指错误、腿部/脚部畸形、僵硬的姿势、强烈的 HDR、过度锐化、杂乱的游客、文字、水印、Logo。
